text: Why do one-time shampoo buyers not return?
decisionItInforms: Whether to run a replenishment reminder or review the formula.
currentAssumption: They don't come back because of price.

text: How do customers describe their everyday shower routine?
decisionItInforms: Wording and moments for the 'everyday routine' body wash campaign.
currentAssumption: Mornings are rushed, so speed is the main message.

text: What would make moisturiser buyers reorder before they run out?
decisionItInforms: Whether to offer a moisturiser refill bundle at checkout.
currentAssumption: Buyers forget to reorder; a reminder alone will fix it.
